q.zh: GDL 对象最终由什么生成？
q.en: What ultimately produces a GDL object?

explain.zh: GDL 是描述式的：脚本写清楚形体、符号和参数，Archicad 负责生成。改脚本即改对象，不需要重新建模。
explain.en: GDL is descriptive: scripts state the geometry, symbol and parameters, and Archicad generates the result. Change the script and the object changes — no remodelling.

q.zh: 对象在平面图上显示成什么样，由哪个脚本决定？
q.en: Which script decides how the object looks in plan?

explain.zh: 2D 脚本画平面符号，3D 脚本画三维形体，界面脚本只负责设置对话框。三者互相独立。
explain.en: The 2D script draws the plan symbol, the 3D script builds the solid, and the UI script only lays out the settings dialog. They are independent.

q.zh: 想让一个图库部件能被放进项目，前提是什么？
q.en: What must be true before a library part can be placed in a project?

zh: 它被编译成独立的可执行程序
它有正确的子类型并且所在图库已加载
en: It has been uploaded to the cloud
It has been compiled into a standalone program
It has the right subtype and its library is loaded

explain.zh: 子类型决定它能不能放在墙上、地上；图库没加载，项目里就找不到这个部件。
explain.en: The subtype decides whether it can go on a wall or the floor; if the library is not loaded, the project cannot find the part at all.

q.zh: `BLOCK 2, 0.6, 0.05` 这三个数分别表示什么？
q.en: What do the three numbers in `BLOCK 2, 0.6, 0.05` mean?

en: Sizes along X, Y and Z
The coordinates of the insertion point

explain.zh: BLOCK 的参数是长宽高，不是一个点。位置靠变换命令（ADD）决定，尺寸和位置是两件事。
explain.en: BLOCK takes width, depth and height — not a point. Position comes from transformation commands such as ADD; size and placement are separate concerns.

q.zh: GDL 的局部坐标系里，Z 轴指向哪里？
q.en: In the GDL local coordinate system, where does the Z axis point?

explain.zh: GDL 用 Z 轴向上的右手坐标系，画楼板、墙体时高度就是 Z。Three.js 里会映射成 Y 向上，那只是渲染层的换算。
explain.en: GDL uses a right-handed system with Z up, so heights go along Z. Three.js maps that to Y up — a renderer-level conversion only.

q.zh: 画完一个物体后再执行 `ADD 1, 0, 0`，下一个物体的位置会怎样？
q.en: After drawing one body you run `ADD 1, 0, 0`. Where does the next body go?

zh: 沿 Z 轴抬高 1 米
沿 X 轴偏移 1 米
en: 1 metre along X from the previous position

explain.zh: ADD 平移的是当前坐标系，之后画的物体都按新原点定位，直到 DEL 退回。
explain.en: ADD shifts the current coordinate frame; everything drawn afterwards uses the new origin until DEL pops it.

q.zh: `DEL 1` 的作用是什么？
q.en: What does `DEL 1` do?

zh: 删除最后画的一个物体

explain.zh: DEL 是退栈，不是删除几何。常见误解之一：以为 DEL 会删掉物体，其实它只恢复上一层坐标系。
explain.en: DEL pops the stack — it does not delete geometry. A common misconception is that it removes bodies; it only restores the previous frame.

q.zh: 变换堆栈的出入顺序是？
q.en: In what order does the transformation stack work?

explain.zh: 和函数调用栈一样是后进先出：最后压入的变换最先被 DEL 弹出。压了几层就要退几层。
explain.en: It is last-in-first-out like a call stack: the most recently pushed frame is popped first. Push N levels, pop N levels.

q.zh: 循环里每轮都 ADD 却从不 DEL，最可能的后果是？
q.en: A loop calls ADD every iteration but never DEL. What is the likely result?

zh: 偏移量逐轮累加，物体越跑越远
en: Offsets accumulate and bodies drift away

explain.zh: 没有 DEL，上一轮的偏移会留给下一轮，位置层层叠加。要么循环内 DEL 退回，要么用绝对坐标。
explain.en: Without DEL the previous offset carries into the next iteration and stacks up. Either pop inside the loop or use absolute coordinates.

q.zh: 参数在哪里定义？
q.en: Where are parameters defined?

en: At the top of the 3D script
At the end of the UI script

explain.zh: 参数列表定义名称、类型、默认值与取值范围；脚本里只是使用它们，不能顺手新建参数。
explain.en: The parameter list defines name, type, default and range. Scripts only consume parameters — they cannot create new ones on the fly.

q.zh: 下面哪个是合法的参数类型？
q.en: Which of these is a valid parameter type?

explain.zh: GDL 参数类型包括长度、角度、整数、实数、字符串、布尔、材质等，没有「图层」这种类型；材质用索引号引用。
explain.en: GDL types include length, angle, integer, real, string, boolean and material — there is no layer type; materials are referenced by index.

q.zh: 改了参数值但模型没变化，最可能的原因是？
q.en: You change a parameter but the model does not move. Most likely cause?

zh: 脚本里根本没用到这个参数
en: The script never uses that parameter

explain.zh: 先搜脚本里有没有出现这个参数名。参数只是输入，不写进命令就不会有任何效果。
explain.en: Search the scripts for the parameter name first. A parameter is only an input — if no command uses it, nothing happens.

q.zh: 在平面图上画一条线段用哪个命令？
q.en: Which command draws a line segment in plan?

explain.zh: 二维命令都带 2 后缀：LINE2、ARC2、POLY2。LINE3 是三维线，BLOCK 是实体。
explain.en: 2D commands carry a 2 suffix: LINE2, ARC2, POLY2. LINE3 draws in 3D and BLOCK creates a solid.

q.zh: 2D 脚本会影响什么？
q.en: What does the 2D script affect?

zh: 平面图与剖面里的符号
en: The symbol in plan and section views

explain.zh: 2D 脚本只负责二维符号；三维形体由 3D 脚本负责，两者不要混着改。
explain.en: The 2D script only draws the 2D symbol; the 3D script owns the solid. Do not mix the two.

q.zh: 对象在平面图上完全看不到，最先该检查什么？
q.en: An object is invisible in plan. What should you check first?

explain.zh: 没有 2D 脚本就没有平面符号，这是最常见的原因；其次是图层与画笔颜色。
explain.en: No 2D script means no plan symbol — the usual culprit. Layer and pen colour come next.

q.zh: GDL 的 FOR 循环以什么结束？
q.en: How does a GDL FOR loop end?

explain.zh: FOR ... TO ... STEP ... NEXT；END 用于 IF / 宏等结构，RETURN 用于子程序返回。
explain.en: FOR ... TO ... STEP ... NEXT. END closes IF and similar blocks; RETURN leaves a subroutine.

q.zh: 用 GOSUB 调用子程序后，靠什么返回？
q.en: After calling a subroutine with GOSUB, what returns control?

explain.zh: GOSUB 跳到标签，执行到 RETURN 回到调用处；忘记 RETURN 会一路执行到脚本末尾并报错。
explain.en: GOSUB jumps to a label and RETURN comes back; forgetting RETURN runs to the end of the script and errors out.

q.zh: `IF cond THEN` 后面只写了一条语句，条件不成立时会怎样？
q.en: `IF cond THEN` is followed by a single statement. What happens when the condition is false?

zh: 跳过这一条，继续往下执行
en: That statement is skipped and execution continues

explain.zh: 单行 IF 只控制紧随其后的一条语句。要多条语句受控，用 IF ... THEN ... ENDIF 块。
explain.en: A single-line IF controls only the next statement. Wrap several statements in IF ... THEN ... ENDIF.

q.zh: PRISM 与 BLOCK 的核心区别是什么？
q.en: What is the key difference between PRISM and BLOCK?

zh: PRISM 按自定义轮廓挤出，BLOCK 只能是长方体
en: PRISM extrudes a custom contour; BLOCK is always a box

explain.zh: BLOCK 固定是长方体；PRISM 用一组轮廓点挤出任意形状，墙、柱、台面都靠它。
explain.en: BLOCK is always a box; PRISM extrudes any contour, which is how walls, columns and countertops are built.

q.zh: 用 PRISM 画一个盒状物体，需要在轮廓里做什么？
q.en: To build a box-like solid with PRISM, what must the contour do?

zh: 首尾点重复，形成闭合轮廓
en: Repeat the first point to close the contour

explain.zh: 轮廓按顺序给出顶点，最后回到起点——首尾重复一次，Archicad 才知道形状闭合。
explain.en: List the vertices in order and return to the start — repeating the first point tells Archicad the shape is closed.

q.zh: 想在板中间开一个圆孔，PRISM 能直接做到吗？
q.en: Can PRISM cut a round hole through a slab directly?

zh: 不能，需要组运算或专门的洞口命令
en: Yes, just add a circle to the contour
No — use a group operation or a dedicated hole command

explain.zh: PRISM 只画实心体，不能自带孔洞。开洞要靠 GROUP 组运算做差集。
explain.en: PRISM only creates a solid; holes need a boolean subtraction via GROUP operations.

q.zh: REVOLVE 让截面绕哪条轴旋转？
q.en: Around which axis does REVOLVE rotate its profile?

zh: 局部坐标系的 X 轴

explain.zh: REVOLVE 固定绕 X 轴；要换旋转轴，先用变换命令把坐标系摆好。
explain.en: REVOLVE always turns around the local X axis; move the frame first if you need another axis.

q.zh: 用 REVOLVE 旋转 180° 而不是整周时，会发生什么？
q.en: What happens when REVOLVE turns 180° instead of a full circle?

zh: 自动补上端盖，得到半个实体
en: End caps are added, giving a half solid
It mirrors into a full turn

explain.zh: 非整周旋转会自动补两端封口，否则模型是敞口的，渲染时会看穿内部。
explain.en: A partial revolution adds caps at both ends; without them the solid is open and you see straight through it.

q.zh: EXTRUDE 与 PRISM 的主要差别是什么？
q.en: How does EXTRUDE differ from PRISM?

zh: EXTRUDE 可以沿任意方向向量挤出
en: EXTRUDE extrudes along an arbitrary vector

explain.zh: PRISM 沿竖直方向挤出；EXTRUDE 给一个方向向量，斜向、水平的形体都能做。
explain.en: PRISM extrudes vertically; EXTRUDE takes a direction vector, so sloped and horizontal solids are possible.

q.zh: GDL 里指定材质用什么？
q.en: How do you assign a material in GDL?

explain.zh: 命令只认索引号。名称是给人看的，脚本里写名字会直接报参数类型错误。
explain.en: Commands only accept an index. Names are for humans; passing one raises a type error.

q.zh: 把对象拿到另一个项目里，材质变了，最可能的原因是什么？
q.en: An object's material changes when moved to another project. Most likely reason?

zh: 两个项目的材质索引顺序不同
en: The two projects order materials differently

explain.zh: 索引是项目内的编号，不是全局身份证。跨项目复用要核对索引，或者按名称查号。
explain.en: An index is project-local, not a global ID. When reusing across projects, verify the index or look it up by name.

q.zh: 平面图上的填充图案由哪类属性决定？
q.en: Which attribute controls the hatch pattern in plan?

explain.zh: Fill 管 2D 图案，Material 管 3D 表面渲染，Line Type 管虚线样式，三者别混。
explain.en: Fill handles 2D patterns, Material handles 3D surface rendering and Line Type handles dashes — keep them apart.

q.zh: 主脚本的主要职责是什么？
q.en: What is the master script mainly responsible for?

zh: 传参与前置计算，供其他脚本使用
en: Passing parameters and doing upfront calculation for other scripts

explain.zh: 主脚本先执行，常放公共变量与派生尺寸；画图交给 2D/3D 脚本，对话框交给界面脚本。
explain.en: It runs first and usually holds shared variables and derived sizes. Drawing belongs to the 2D/3D scripts, the dialog to the UI script.

q.zh: 调用宏时参数怎么传？
q.en: How are parameters passed when calling a macro?

zh: 宏直接读调用者的变量
在 CALL / MACRO 命令里按顺序列出
en: The macro reads the caller's variables
List them in order in the CALL / MACRO command

explain.zh: 宏只能看到自己收到的参数，看不到调用者的局部变量。要共用数据就显式传进去。
explain.en: A macro only sees the parameters it receives — not the caller's local variables. Pass shared data explicitly.

q.zh: 脚本调用宏时报「找不到宏」，最可能是？
q.en: A script calling a macro reports that it cannot find it. Most likely cause?

zh: 宏所在图库没加载，或名称写错
en: The master script is too long
The macro has too many parameters
Its library is not loaded, or the name is wrong

explain.zh: 宏是按名称在图库里查找的。图库没加载、改了名、挪了文件夹，都会导致找不到。
explain.en: Macros are resolved by name inside loaded libraries. An unloaded library, a rename or a moved folder all break it.

q.zh: 一个对象想放到墙上并自动开洞，必须满足什么？
q.en: What must an object have to be placed in a wall and cut an opening?

zh: 名称里带 Door 或 Window
en: The word Door or Window in its name

explain.zh: 识别宿主墙的能力来自子类型，不是几何形状，也不是名称。
explain.en: Host-wall awareness comes from the subtype — not from the shape and not from the name.

q.zh: 门窗在墙上开的洞口由什么定义？
q.en: What defines the opening a door or window cuts?

explain.zh: 洞口是二维轮廓沿墙厚方向切出来的，所以 WALLHOLE 用的还是 2D 坐标。
explain.en: The opening is a 2D contour cut through the wall thickness, so WALLHOLE still works in 2D coordinates.

q.zh: 改了门宽参数后，最容易被忽略的同步项是什么？
q.en: After changing the door width parameter, what is most often forgotten?

zh: 洞口与门框、门扇一起更新
en: Updating the opening together with frame and leaf

explain.zh: 门宽一变，洞口、门框、门扇、把手位置都要跟着走，否则会出现「门比洞宽」的穿模。
explain.en: Width drives the opening, frame, leaf and handle positions together — miss one and the leaf pokes through the wall.

q.zh: 想把数值参数 width 显示成文字，正确做法是？
q.en: You want to show the numeric parameter width as text. What is correct?

zh: 用 STR(width, …) 转成字符串再画
直接把 width 传给 TEXT2
把参数类型改成字符串
en: Change the parameter type to string

explain.zh: TEXT2 只收字符串。数值必须先 STR 转换，否则类型不匹配。
explain.en: TEXT2 only accepts strings; numbers must go through STR first.

q.zh: GDL 里拼接两个字符串用什么？
q.en: How do you concatenate two strings in GDL?

explain.zh: 字符串用 + 连接，例如 "W=" + STR(width, 5, 2)。
explain.en: Use + to join strings, e.g. "W=" + STR(width, 5, 2).

q.zh: STR 的宽度参数设得太小会怎样？
q.en: What happens if the width argument of STR is too small?

zh: 结果被截断或出现星号，需要留足宽度
en: It raises an error and stops
The result is truncated or starred — leave enough width

explain.zh: STR 按固定宽度输出，宽度不够就丢字符或用星号占位。宁可给宽一点。
explain.en: STR pads to a fixed width; too narrow and characters are dropped or replaced with stars. Give it room.

q.zh: 做参数化柜体，第一步应该确定什么？
q.en: When building a parametric cabinet, what comes first?

en: Key dimensions and the parameter list

explain.zh: 先把宽、高、深、板厚、层数定成参数，脚本才有稳定的输入；否则后面边画边改。
explain.en: Define width, height, depth, board thickness and shelf count as parameters first; scripts need stable inputs.

q.zh: 板厚为什么不应该写死在 BLOCK 里？
q.en: Why should board thickness not be hard-coded in BLOCK calls?

zh: 改参数时所有板件无法同步
en: All boards cannot follow when the value changes
Archicad does not allow fixed numbers

explain.zh: 板厚是典型联动尺寸：顶板、底板、侧板、层板都用它。写死一处，改规格就得逐个改。
explain.en: Thickness is a shared dimension: top, bottom, sides and shelves all use it. Hard-coding means edits everywhere.

q.zh: 层板数量要能随时增减，脚本该怎么写？
q.en: Shelf count must change freely. How should the script be written?

zh: 把每块层板都复制一遍代码
用 FOR 循环按数量重复画
en: Copy the code for every shelf
Repeat with a FOR loop based on the count

explain.zh: 层板是重复构件：循环 + 参数化间距，数量改成 3 或 8 都不用动结构。
explain.en: Shelves repeat: a loop plus parametric spacing handles 3 or 8 without structural changes.

q.zh: 参数列表、参数脚本、UI 脚本三者各管什么？
q.en: What do the parameter list, parameter script and UI script each handle?

explain.zh: 参数列表定义名字、类型、默认值；参数脚本写取值范围与联动；UI 脚本只决定控件怎么摆。
explain.en: The list defines name, type and default; the parameter script sets ranges and links; the UI script only arranges controls.

q.zh: 想让某个参数由公式自动算出、用户手改无效，用哪个语句？
q.en: Which statement makes a parameter computed by a formula and not editable by hand?

explain.zh: PARAMETERS 每次运行都重算；LOCK 只是不许用户改，脚本里仍能赋值；HIDEPARAMETER 直接从列表隐藏。
explain.en: PARAMETERS recomputes on every run; LOCK merely blocks user edits while scripts can still assign; HIDEPARAMETER hides it from the list.

q.zh: 写 UI 脚本时，下列哪个说法是对的？
q.en: Which statement about the UI script is correct?

zh: 一个部件里可以开多个对话框
整个脚本就是一个对话框，没有结束语句
en: One part can open several dialogs
The whole script is one dialog with no closing statement

explain.zh: UI 脚本没有 UI_ENDDIALOG / UI_ENDPAGE，也没有第二个对话框；别照着别的语言习惯去补结束标签。
explain.en: There is no UI_ENDDIALOG or UI_ENDPAGE and no second dialog in a part; do not add closing tags out of habit.

q.zh: 用 GROUP 定义好体块后，模型里却什么都没有，最可能漏了什么？
q.en: After defining solids with GROUP nothing appears. What is most likely missing?

explain.zh: 组定义只是「登记」，必须 PLACEGROUP 才真正生成几何，而且漏了也不会报错。
explain.en: GROUP only registers the solids; PLACEGROUP generates the geometry, and forgetting it raises no error.

q.zh: `SUBGROUP("panel", "hole")` 得到的是什么？
q.en: What does `SUBGROUP("panel", "hole")` produce?

explain.zh: 差集顺序敏感：第一个参数是被减的对象。写反就是拿一块小洞去减整块板，结果为空。
explain.en: Subtraction is order-sensitive: the first argument is the one being cut. Reversed, you cut a panel out of a small hole and get nothing.

q.zh: 做一个可拖拽改长度参数的热区，最少要哪三个点？
q.en: Which three points are needed for a draggable length hotspot?

explain.zh: 参数值 = 基准点到移动点的距离，正方向由参考点指向基准点决定。只写移动点是拖不动的。
explain.en: The value is the distance from base to moving point, and the positive direction goes from reference to base. A moving point alone will not drag.

q.zh: GLOB 全局变量的读写规则是？
q.en: What is the read/write rule for GLOB variables?

en: Writable only in the master script

explain.zh: 全局变量由 Archicad 注入，只能读。它们在宏调用时也不像变换栈那样保存和恢复。
explain.en: Global variables are injected by Archicad and are read-only. Unlike the transformation stack they are not saved and restored across macro calls.

q.zh: `GLOB_SCALE` 等于 100 表示什么？哪些尺寸才需要乘它？
q.en: `GLOB_SCALE` equals 100. What does that mean, and which sizes should be multiplied by it?

explain.zh: 模型几何一律按真实尺寸写；只有希望「纸上看起来固定大小」的字高、符号、箭头才乘比例。
explain.en: Model geometry is always real size. Only text height, symbols and arrows that should look fixed on paper get multiplied.

q.zh: `REQUEST` 的正确用法是？
q.en: How should `REQUEST` be used?

zh: 当变量用，赋一次值就固定
当函数用，n = REQUEST(...) 接收返回值

explain.zh: REQUEST 是函数，返回值是成功填入的变量个数（1 成功 / 0 失败），必须用赋值语句接住。
explain.en: REQUEST is a function returning how many outputs were filled (1 success, 0 failure); it must be captured with an assignment.

q.zh: GDL 数组的下标从几开始？
q.en: What is the first index of a GDL array?

explain.zh: GDL 数组从 1 起。固定长度数组写错下标当场报错，动态数组则可能读到无意义的垃圾值。
explain.en: GDL arrays start at 1. Fixed arrays error immediately on a bad index; dynamic arrays may silently return garbage.

q.zh: `OPEN` 返回 -1 表示什么？
q.en: What does `OPEN` returning -1 mean?

en: The file does not exist (or cannot be opened)

explain.zh: 正数是通道号，-1 文件不存在，-2 缺 Add-On。所以必须先判 `> 0` 再用通道。
explain.en: A positive number is the channel, -1 means the file is missing and -2 means the Add-On is absent. Check `> 0` before using the channel.

q.zh: 想把数据覆盖写入一个新 CSV，`mode` 应设成什么？
q.en: Which `mode` overwrites a CSV with new data?

explain.zh: wo 只写并先清空原文件，wa 是追加写，ro 只读。没有 rw，读写要分两次打开。
explain.en: wo writes and truncates first, wa appends and ro reads. There is no rw — open twice when you need both.

q.zh: 让 GSM 能进 git 逐行 review，应该怎么做？
q.en: How do you make a GSM reviewable line by line in git?

zh: 用 LP_XMLConverter 转成 XML 再入库
直接把 GSM 提交，git 会解析
en: Convert it to XML with LP_XMLConverter and commit that
Commit the GSM; git parses it

explain.zh: GSM 是二进制容器，git 只能看出「变了」。团队做法是 XML 进 git，GSM 只作为发布产物放 dist。
explain.en: GSM is a binary container, so git only sees that it changed. Teams commit the XML and keep the GSM as a build artefact.

q.zh: 「检查脚本」（Check Script）做什么？
q.en: What does Check Script do?

zh: 只做语法与参数校验，不生成几何
en: Syntax and parameter checks only, no geometry

explain.zh: 它不画模型，报错信息比在 3D 窗口里瞎找快得多。四个脚本都要各跑一次。
explain.en: It draws nothing; its messages are far faster than hunting in the 3D window. Run it on all four scripts.

q.zh: 跨项目或升级版本时，引用材质、填充用什么更稳？
q.en: What is more robust for materials and fills across projects or versions?

explain.zh: 编号是项目内的顺序，换项目或版本可能重排。用名称查找虽然多一步，但不会悄悄指向别的属性。
explain.en: Index numbers follow project order and can be reshuffled by a new project or version. Name lookup costs one step but never silently picks the wrong attribute.

q.zh: 门扇与门框之间为什么要留 3 mm 缝？
q.en: Why leave a 3 mm gap between leaf and frame?

zh: 避免共面导致 3D 闪烁

explain.zh: 两个面完全贴合会出现闪烁（z-fighting）。这条缝还是关门时的正常构造缝。
explain.en: Two coincident faces cause z-fighting flicker. The gap is also the normal construction clearance.

q.zh: 门扇在墙厚方向居中，Y 坐标应该怎么写？
q.en: How should the leaf Y coordinate centre it in the wall?

explain.zh: 要减掉扇厚再取半，扇子才真正居中；墙厚参数一变，位置自动跟着走。
explain.en: Subtract the leaf thickness before halving so it is truly centred; the position then follows wallT automatically.

q.zh: 一次完整的对象交付，除了 GSM 还应该包含什么？
q.en: Besides the GSM, what should a complete delivery include?

zh: 可 diff 的 XML、参数说明文档、符号截图与发布记录
en: Diffable XML, a parameter guide, symbol screenshots and release notes

explain.zh: 没有说明书的对象等于没交付。参数说明要写清什么时候用、哪些值是禁忌。
explain.en: An object without documentation is not delivered. The guide must state when each parameter applies and which values are forbidden.
